summary: Added sparse-coverage detection (threshold env var, machine-readable marker, SPARSE_PROMPT_NEEDED directive) to literature-briefing.sh and literature-lit-flag-resolve.sh. Reconciled the drifted Stage 4a flow into one shared core-context block all six --lit skills import, adding a 'Search online to ingest' option and fixing the orchestrator_mode autonomy contract. All 7 phases complete; check-extension-docs.sh passes.
decisions_made: Sparsity boundary is strictly < threshold (never <=), default 3, overridable via LITERATURE_SPARSE_THRESHOLD.
Shared Stage 4a block placed in core context (not the literature extension) so its @-import resolves regardless of extension selection.
Autonomous SPARSE_PROMPT_NEEDED reuses the existing sparse sub-index rather than launching a fresh global search; online ingest stays interactive-only in every autonomous branch.
orchestrator_mode now passed true uniformly for research/plan/implement dispatches in both orchestrate skills, with a dual-consumer doc note added at both consumer sites.
